question: Should gateway JSON error.message and media reason fields remain stable English/protocol-adjacent strings while runtime chat copy is localized, or may they become locale-dependent display fields?
rationale: The diff changes fields that clients may consume from gateway JSON; repository policy treats protocol, provider routing, and compatibility-sensitive surfaces as requiring maintainer-visible direction rather than assuming display-only semantics.

options.title: Keep Gateway Fields Stable
options.body: Localize chat/UI-facing runtime copy but leave gateway JSON message/reason fields stable unless a separate API contract change documents them as display-only.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Display Fields
options.body: Treat stable code/type fields as the client contract and allow message/reason text to follow the selected locale.

options.title: Split Runtime I18n Scope
options.body: Land channel/runtime copy first and defer gateway JSON localization to a narrower compatibility-reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Keep Gateway Fields Stable
recommendation.body: Localize chat/UI-facing runtime copy but leave gateway JSON message/reason fields stable unless a separate API contract change documents them as display-only.

likelyOwner.reason: The i18n infrastructure and product-scope boundary were recently reviewed and merged through this adjacent path.
